correctness.rationale: The frozen method definition uses I both for the lower cumulative quadrature (first row zero) and for the identity in all three solves, an ambiguity that makes the literal sweep inconsistent for x0≠0. The corrected RESULT separates these matrices and matches the identity in the frozen checker. For the corrected, intended method, the lower block of Q²−Xvv is H. The initial velocity-column error is −c+O(z) and the position-column error is O(z). Propagating and applying the endpoint functional gives the asserted z^(k+1) bottom-right perturbation; the top-right perturbation enters the determinant with a further factor O(z). The exact collocation determinant is one. The Cayley–Hamilton recurrence checks the first four signs exactly; conjugation sqrt(3)↦−sqrt(3) makes the conjugate of qH^k c positive, eliminating the potentially unclassified zero. The other conjugate of 2cos(2θ) is below −2, so the phase is irrational. Schur’s other two inequalities have positive leading terms z and 4, and both signs occur on half the circle, separately also on each parity subsequence. This rechecks the final corrected claim without requiring any numerical extrapolation.
residual_risks: Asymptotics hold at each fixed k, not uniformly over sweep count; the finite tests do not prove the density.
